subject: Post-call follow-up: deployment mode & urgent capacity for FinLytics
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Angela Park <angela@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-18T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call follow-up: deployment mode & urgent capacity for FinLytics

Hi Angela —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment: 

What we heard
- Primary workload: real-time customer support ranking + reranking for chat (p99 generation ~350ms today)
- Current setup: using Redwood hosted API for inference; experienced a throttling incident this morning during a traffic spike (thank you for sharing the logs).
- Requirements driving mode decision: predictable throughput during peak windows, data isolation for PII, and SOC2 evidence for procurement.

Options we discussed
1) Continue on Hosted API with aggressive rate limits and caching — fastest, lowest friction, but may surface throttling during spikes.
2) Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool) — predictable throughput/SLOs and faster turnaround; can be provisioned as an expedited "burst" in some regions.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem) — strongest isolation and compliance but longer lead time (procurement + on-prem install).

Immediate ask (from you): understand timeline and short-term mitigation for the incident; advise whether we can get Dedicated capacity ASAP while we evaluate Private.

Next steps I propose
- Rishi: follow up with initial capacity recommendation and timeline for an expedited Dedicated pool. (Rishi — can you confirm ETA?)
- Angela / FinLytics: share the incident logs and peak qps for the last 72 hours (attached if convenient).
- I will loop in our sales ops and account lead if we need an expedited credit/contract path.

Attached: discovery-notes.pdf (short call recap)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m technical kickoff whenever you have availability today.

Best,
Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Angela Park <angela@finlytics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@finlytics.com>, support@finlytics.com
Date: 2026-07-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call follow-up: deployment mode & urgent capacity for FinLytics

Connor —

Thanks for the recap. Urgent note: we had a significant outage this morning between 07:40–08:05 PDT where requests started getting 429s and several retries caused downstream queueing. I attached the error log extract (finlytics-error-log.txt) and our support ticket number.

To be explicit: our execs are asking if Dedicated capacity can be provisioned immediately (or within 24–48 hours) as a stopgap. If Dedicated is not achievable that fast, we need clarity on whether we should pursue Private (we have procurement constraints and may need to start that path today).

Compliance: SOC2 is a hard requirement for us; we need evidence and the timeline for Private onboarding if we go that route.

Availability: we can do a technical kickoff today at 15:00 PDT. Please confirm.

-Angela
VP Product, FinLytics
Attached: finlytics-error-log.txt, SOC2-requirements.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Angela Park <angela@finlytics.com>
Date: 2026-07-18T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call follow-up: deployment mode & urgent capacity for FinLytics

On Sat, Jul 18, 2026 at 10:05 AM Angela Park <angela@finlytics.com> wrote:
> Connor —
> 
> Thanks for the recap. Urgent note: we had a significant outage this morning ...

Thanks for the details, Angela — I reviewed the error snippets. Short summary from engineering:
- The 429s line up with a sustained QPS spike ~3x normal peak, our rate limiter was triggered and active retrying amplified the load.
- Quick mitigation we can do today: enable request-level caching for common prefixes and bump Hosted API concurrency for your API key (temporary and subject to global capacity). This is useful but not a guaranteed fix if spikes persist.
- For a deterministic outcome we recommend Dedicated capacity. ETA estimates:
  - Expedited "burst" Dedicated pool (limited GPUs, managed staging): ~24–48 hours to get a staging pool and traffic cutover; full reserved pool with full throughput ~3–5 business days depending on region and provisioning queue.
  - Private (VPC/on-prem): likely 4–8 weeks (procurement + network setup + customer onboarding).

I attached an initial-capacity-plan.xlsx with our recommended sizing and a checklist of what we need from FinLytics to expedite (VPN details for Private, peak qps by hour, example payload sizes).

Connor — if we escalate to Ops for an expedited Dedicated allocation, we should include a short mutual action plan and a temporary SLA/burst credit offer to keep the customer stable.

-- Rishi
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attached: initial-capacity-plan.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Angela Park <angela@finlytics.com>
Date: 2026-07-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call follow-up: deployment mode & urgent capacity for FinLytics

Connor / team —

Marking this as an urgent escalation. Proposal for immediate path:
1) Offer an expedited Dedicated burst allocation to FinLytics (24–48hr staging window) to stop the 429s and stabilize production.
2) While stabilized, run parallel evaluation for Private (if they decide procurement path) or a standard Dedicated reserved contract.
3) Offer a 2-week good-faith credit if provisioning timelines slip beyond the committed ETA.

Laura — can you approve an ad-hoc credit cap of up to $10k to be applied if Ops misses the 48hr target? We should also confirm pricing uplift for expedited provisioning. If approved, I'll prepare a short DocuSign addendum to accelerate the process.

Connor — please confirm FinLytics is good to proceed with the Dedicated burst and confirm the 15:00 PDT kickoff.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Attached: proposed-credits.docx
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-call follow-up: deployment mode & urgent capacity for FinLytics

Angela —

Thanks for the quick reply. Per the team: we can provision an expedited Dedicated burst pool and start the cutover within 24–48 hours. We've looped in Sales Ops and account lead for a credit approval path.

Confirmed: 15:00 PDT for a technical kickoff — I’ll send a calendar invite in a minute. Please have one technical contact and a network contact on the call (Rishi will drive the cutover checklist).

If you want to proceed immediately with the dedicated burst, I can send an expedited DocuSign addendum once Laura approves the credit uplift (link below).

DocuSign (expedited addendum): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ENVELOPE-12345

Looking forward to stabilizing things quickly.

—Connor
